capabilities: organize tasks into separate views for work and school
add due dates that turn red when overdue
link tasks to notes in the vault
edit and remove subjects and tasks
disambiguation: Not a general to-do app; it is built around schoolwork with subjects and work/school views.
extras: The README warns that completing a task cannot be undone.
problem: Obsidian's task lists don't organize schoolwork by subject or view, or highlight overdue assignments with due dates.
summary: A dedicated homework tracker with views, subjects, and tasks that have due dates and links to vault notes.
